name: Bun moc Kim Son
summary: Rice noodles in broth with pork balls the size of a child’s fist, made from leg meat seasoned with fish sauce and pepper, spread on banana leaf, and boiled.
howToEat: Eat it with banana flower, kinh giới, tía tô, húng quê, bean sprouts, rau răm, lime or kumquat, chili vinegar, and pepper.
seoTitle: Bun moc Kim Son — pork-ball noodles
seoDescription: Kim Sơn bún mọc: fist-sized pork balls boiled on banana leaf, with a heap of herbs and banana flower.
